highlights: highly sought after west end location
description:
No onward chain. Set within a picturesque location overlooking local parkland is this beautiful family home. Having a highly sought after West End location close to Cockerton Village Green and the town centre, this home benefits from spacious accommodation and garage. In addition there is also an attractive rear garden and viewing is highly recommended. The accommodation is entered via wooden door with sidelight which opens into the reception hallway. There is access to two reception rooms and the kitchen. Both reception rooms are good sizes and have a bright and spacious appeal. The kitchen is also a good sized room and has doorway to the side. The staircase from the hallway leads to the first floor landing. From the landing there is access to three bedrooms, the main bathroom and a separate w/c. Two of the bedrooms are great sized double rooms and the third room is a spacious single. The bathroom is fitted with white suite and there is a separate w/c. Externally the garden to the front is enclosed by wall and is mainly laid to lawn with shrubbery borders. There is a driveway for off street parking which leads to the garage. To the rear the garden is again enclosed and provides attractive flower bed areas together with shrubbery and patio area. In our opinion this West End property is situated within a highly regarded and convenient location and provides an ideal opportunity for a variety of occupiers including families.

RECEPTION HALLWAY With staircase to the first floor and storage cupboard.

LIVING ROOM Bright and spacious reception room with window to the front.

DINING ROOM Further bright and spacious room with window to the rear.

KITCHEN Separate room with fitted units, worktop, tiled splashback areas, sink unit, space for appliances, pantry cupboard, window to rear and door to side.

FIRST FLOOR LANDNING Access to upstairs accommodation.

BEDROOM ONE Good sized double room with window to front.

BEDROOM TWO Further double room with window to rear.

BEDROOM THREE Single room with window to front.

BATHROOM With window to rear and fitted with suite comprising bath and sink.

SEPARATE W/C With window to rear and fitted with w/c.

EXTERNALLY

The garden to the front is enclosed by wall and is mainly laid to lawn with shrubbery borders. There is a driveway for off street parking which leads to the garage. To the rear the garden is again enclosed and provides attractive flower bed areas together with shrubbery and patio area.

GENERAL INFORMATION Council Tax - Band C Please note all measurements including floorplans are approximate only.
